title: Time Out Ranks the World's Best Cities for Cycling
paragraphs: Which cities are the best for riding a bicycle? According to a new ranking by Time Out, the answer is a small university city in England.

The ranking was published in September 2026. It is based on Time Out's yearly survey of more than 24,000 people who live in cities around the world. They were asked how easy it is to ride a bicycle where they live. The cities on the list had the highest number of people who said cycling was "good" or "amazing." Only the top city from each country was included.

Cambridge, in the UK, was first, with 83.2%. The city is small and flat, and it does not rain very much there. It also has a large parking building for bicycles at the train station. About one in three trips in Cambridge are made by bicycle.

Montreal, in Canada, was second, with 82.5%. The city has more than 1,000 kilometers of bike lanes, and it plans to build more protected lanes that will be cleared of snow in winter. Copenhagen, in Denmark, was third, with 79.2%. It has many bike lanes, and in some places, cars must drive at only 20 kilometers per hour.

Several cities in Asia also did well. Shanghai, in China, was fourth. It has a 24-kilometer path by the river with no cars. However, fast traffic and electric scooters can be dangerous for cyclists there. Taipei was eighth, and Seoul was 11th. However, Tokyo was not on the list.

Other cities in the top 10 were Vienna, Warsaw, Marrakech, Stockholm and Seville. Vienna, in fifth place, has about 1,800 kilometers of bike lanes. Seville, in Spain, is flat and has special traffic lights just for bicycles. The only American city in the top 20 was Orlando, in 16th place.
